body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2008') -- <Visual News> SEE-ON Technology(www.see-on.com) presented its 7-inch car pc 'Car PC Neo' during CES 2008, which is based on Windows XP Embedded OS.
Adopting 7-inch touch screen monitor with tilt function, it supports MP3, MP4, WMA, AVI and DVD. Other features included DMB, GPS, 3D navigation and HSDPA wireless Internet access.
